done_when: While any check is still in progress, land keeps waiting past the no-progress limit up to a clear upper limit, and when it stops the message says no decision is needed and how to resume

known.title: Keep check-wait timeouts out of the land queue's Needs you summary

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 2
Raise: Functional
Case: normal use - `forge land --all` reaches the wait limit while healthy checks remain running.
This condition suppresses the individual command's `needs you` message, but the queue still puts every nonzero child exit into `needs` at src/forge/land.py:420–425 and reports it under `Needs you` at line 431. Consequently, a routine check-wait timeout still requests human attention in the final summary, contradicting the new refusal's statement that no decision is needed. Preserve the wait-ended distinction in the queue's result handling as well.
findings.title: Keep check-wait timeouts out of the land queue's Needs you summary

why: forge land stops as needs you after 30 minutes while test groups are still running normally (issue 1360)
